evidence.observation: Purge brought O2 down from about 28766 ppm to about 5 ppm, and it has stayed there.
Temperature followed the ramp setpoint; it overshot to 760.6 °C at the start of growth, then settled at 750.0 °C.
Heater power dropped from about 81% during the ramp to a steady ~45% during the hold, which fits holding temperature rather than heating up.
Argon is steady at about 100 sccm and pressure at about 760 Torr.

args.missing_evidence: No reference ranges have been provided, so the ~45% hold power can't be checked against normal runs. No sample characterization exists yet.
